attributes.title: RESNA 2027 at Abilities International
attributes.organizer: Rehabilitation Engineering and Assistive Technology Society of North America
attributes.summary: RESNA's 2027 conference is held within the New York Metro Abilities International Accessibility Conference at the New Jersey Convention & Expo Center in Edison on April 29-30, 2027. It includes sessions, workshops, scientific papers and the Student Design Challenge, and is aimed at clinicians including occupational and physical therapists and assistive technology professionals. IACET CEUs are offered for eligible sessions.
